title: Devcon 8 India
summary: The Ethereum developer community's 2026 Devcon gathering in Mumbai.
description: Devcon 8 brings the Ethereum ecosystem together at the Jio World Centre in Mumbai for four days of technical talks, workshops, and community collaboration.

registration.instructions: Prices differ by eligibility and payment method. The lowest listed youth price is not a general-admission price. Review each ticket description and the seller page.
